hooks.command: [ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook session-start; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook user-prompt-submit; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null || exit 0; factory hook stop; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook stop-failure; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook notification; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook session-end; exit 0
